description: A robot punctured a can of bear repellent at an Amazon warehouse in Robbinsville, New Jersey, exposing 54 workers to fumes and hospitalizing 24, one in critical condition.
Three warehouse robots collided on top of an automated grid system at Ocado's Erith facility, causing a fire that damaged part of the grid and forced thousands of order cancellations.
An Uber Eats food delivery robot designed by Avride entered a crosswalk against a stop signal in Philadelphia and was struck by a truck, dislodging one of its wheels before the robot continued on.
An Uber Eats delivery robot developed by Avride allegedly cut off a cyclist in the bike lane on Varick Street in Jersey City, causing him to go airborne and sustain a concussion and broken clavicle.

An ambulance transporting a patient to a hospital collided with an automated food delivery cart at the intersection of Western and Fountain avenues in Hollywood, causing no additional injuries but requiring the patient to be transferred to a second ambulance.

An LAFD ambulance transporting a patient collided with a Coco food delivery robot at the intersection of Fountain and Western avenues in Hollywood; no injuries were reported but a second ambulance was dispatched to complete the patient's transport.

A Serve Robotics delivery robot blocked and then collided with a West Hollywood man with cerebral palsy riding a mobility scooter on a sidewalk; he reported no physical injury but raised safety and accessibility concerns.
A Coco food delivery robot uprooted a garden, became entangled in a fence, and dragged the fencing down the street in East Hollywood, Los Angeles, causing property damage to a resident's yard.
A Coco delivery robot working for Uber Eats became stuck on railroad tracks in Miami and was struck and destroyed by an oncoming train on January 15, 2026, with no injuries reported.
An Avride delivery robot collided with a cyclist's e-bike at the intersection of Philomena Street and Berkman Drive in Austin, Texas, causing the cyclist serious personal injuries.

A Starship delivery robot at Arizona State University abruptly changed direction, knocked over a university employee, and then reversed toward the victim while she was still on the ground, injuring her.
A Starship food delivery robot reversed into a 73-year-old ASU parking attendant on the Tempe campus, knocking her down and causing a laceration near her left elbow and subsequent back pain.
A Starship food delivery robot was flipped over after being involved in an accident with a car at Georgia Southern University in Statesboro, prompting students to hold a memorial vigil.
A Starship Technologies autonomous delivery robot was struck by a Ford Escape at the University of Kentucky, damaging the robot's wheels, while it appeared to have the right of way.
A Kiwibot delivery robot caught fire on the University of California, Berkeley campus due to a defective battery that had been accidentally installed, destroying the robot.

Co-op delivery robots in Cambridge became confused by fire hoses and fire engines blocking the road during a derelict building fire and had to be carried over the obstructions by Cambridgeshire firefighters.
A 22-year-old trainee engineer was fatally injured after being caught in a robotic arm at NPH Industries, a Kia ancillary unit in Penukonda, Andhra Pradesh.
A Knightscope K5 security robot ran over a 16-month-old toddler at a shopping centre in Silicon Valley, leaving him with swelling to his right foot.
A 48-year-old engineer at Deco-Pak in Hipperholme was fatally crushed by a robotic arm while cleaning a sensor inside the machine's cell, dying from crush injuries to his chest.
Employee is killed by robot while repairing.

At the Ajin USA plant in Cusseta, Alabama, a 20-year-old woman entered a robotic station to clear a sensor fault when the assembly line stopped, and the robot restarted abruptly and crushed her to death.
A 20-year-old worker was killed when a robot at the Ajin USA plant in Cusseta, Alabama restarted abruptly while she was inside a robotic station clearing a sensor fault on a stopped assembly line.

A 20-year-old worker was crushed to death by a robot at the Ajin USA manufacturing plant in Cusseta, Alabama after the machine abruptly restarted while she was inside the operations area attempting to fix a sensor error.
Docket No. 3:20-cr-00093 filed in District Court, M.D. Alabama: criminal case, United States v. Joon LLC. Case closed 2020-11-17.
Auto-parts company fined $1.5 million after worker was killed by a robotic arm

A worker was crushed to death when a robot inside a robotic cell at Ajin USA's Cusseta, Alabama metal stamping plant restarted unexpectedly while she and co-workers were troubleshooting a sensor fault without following lockout/tagout procedures.
A 25-year-old Ford assembly line worker was killed instantly when a robot arm struck him in the head while he was gathering parts in a storage facility at a Ford casting plant in Flat Rock, Michigan.

FAZ reports that the Kassel public prosecutor's office has opened an investigation into the death of the 22-year-old contractor killed by a robot at the Volkswagen Baunatal plant, to determine how the accident happened and whether anyone is to blame.

A robotic system at a Volkswagen plant in Baunatal, Germany grabbed a contractor and pressed him against a metal plate, crushing his chest; he was resuscitated but died shortly afterward at a hospital.

A 49-year-old factory worker in China was impaled by ten steel spikes when a robot malfunctioned and collapsed onto him, injuring his arm and chest; surgeons removed all spikes and he was left in stable condition.

During the opening night of the URKL humanoid robot combat tournament in Shenzhen, an EngineAI T800 robot named 'Matador' had its head knocked off by opponent 'White Eagle' and was knocked out of the fight.

A Tesla Optimus humanoid robot fell backward during a public demonstration at a Tesla store in Miami, dropping water bottles and making hand motions consistent with a teleoperation headset being removed.

A service robot at what social media users claimed was a Haidilao hotpot restaurant in China malfunctioned, knocking plates off a counter and swinging its arms erratically while a staff member attempted to restrain it.
A Russian humanoid robot collapsed face first during a stage showcase.
A Unitree humanoid robot fell twice while performing Michael Jackson's moonwalk at an event organized by robot store Future Era in Shenzhen, China, and had to be dragged off stage by staff.

An AGIBOT Expedition A3 humanoid robot fell and face-planted onto the stage floor while performing a Michael Jackson dance routine at a robotics event in Shenzhen, China, and had to be dragged offstage by a staff member.
A Unitree G1 humanoid robot tested by YouTuber Cody Detwiler spilled food on the floor while attempting to cook stir-fry, slipped on the scattered food, and fell, also causing the owner to slip.
Humanoid robots competed in China's inaugural RoBoLeague football tournament in Beijing, with some falling and requiring 'rescue' during play.
A humanoid robot toppled forward onto rapper Cardi B during a lap dance at the Fanatics Super Bowl Party at Pier 48 in San Francisco; Cardi B was reported unharmed by TMZ.
Cardi B jokingly threatened to sue over the viral clip of the robot falling on her; no lawsuit has been found in court records.
A Tesla Fremont factory robotics technician was struck by a robot arm that suddenly released during disassembly, throwing him to the floor, knocking him unconscious, and causing significant injuries.
Docket No. 9:24-cv-80137 filed in District Court, S.D. Florida: personal injury suit against Intuitive Surgical. Dismissed with prejudice on a joint stipulation; case closed 2024-07-12.

A 71-year-old man died on June 26, 2022, after undergoing robotic surgery to remove prostate cancer at Lawrence + Memorial Hospital in New London on June 3, 2022, with a lawsuit alleging the hospital lacked the resources to safely perform the procedure and failed to transfer him sooner to a major medical center.
A private Tasmanian hospital is being sued over an injury claim related to robotic surgery.

A cat named Sarabi was fatally crushed by an Autoscooper 11 self-cleaning litter box in a Bronx apartment on January 27, 2025, when the device's safety mechanism failed to stop when the animal was inside.
Waymo recalls nearly 3,900 robotaxis over risk of entering closed construction zones

Waymo announced a voluntary software recall after its robotaxis were found to have illegally passed stopped school buses with extended stop signs and flashing lights on multiple occasions in Atlanta and Austin, with no injuries reported.

Waymo robotaxis in Austin, Texas illegally passed stopped school buses with flashing red lights at least 20 times during the 2025 school year, prompting an expanded NHTSA investigation and a voluntary software recall.

Waymo robotaxis in Austin continued to illegally pass stopped school buses with extended stop-arms after a December software recall, with Austin ISD issuing at least four additional citations including one on Monday January 12, 2026.
US safety board opens probe into Waymo robotaxis passing stopped school buses

Waymo recalled 3,067 robotaxis after vehicles repeatedly failed to stop for school buses, including a January 12, 2026 incident in Austin, Texas where a remote assistance agent incorrectly told the autonomous vehicle a school bus was not signaling for drivers to stop, causing it to illegally pass the bus.
NHTSA opened a recall query into about 2,895 Waymo robotaxis over reported passing of stopped school buses, saying most incidents occurred after a software fix
Wybotics recalls robotic pool vacuums due to burn and fire hazards per CPSC.

Waymo recalled 1,212 robotaxis after NHTSA opened a probe into 16 collisions between 2022 and late 2024 in which Waymo vehicles struck chains, gates, and other roadway barriers, with no injuries reported.

Zoox issued a voluntary software recall affecting 332 vehicles after its autonomous driving system caused robotaxis to cross center lane lines or block crosswalks near intersections, with 62 such instances recorded between August 26 and December 5, 2025, and no collisions reported.
Amazon's Zoox recalls 332 US robotaxi vehicles due to a software error.

Medtronic issued an urgent field safety notice in Europe for its Hugo surgical robot's surgeon consoles due to potential main power supply failures, with 25 complaints received including six non-serious injuries and no serious patient harm reported.
Husqvarna recalls all-wheel drive robotic lawnmowers due to fire hazard.

The FDA issued a warning letter to Globus Medical after finding that the company failed to properly investigate complaints of misplaced screws and delayed reporting serious injuries, including spinal cord damage to a patient, associated with its ExcelsiusGPS surgical robot.

CNN analysis of government records and social media videos found hundreds of incidents in which Waymo robotaxis made dangerous maneuvers including running red lights, driving into oncoming traffic and flooded roads, and coming within inches of pedestrians across multiple US cities.

Waymo filed a safety recall with NHTSA (24E-013) for 444 vehicles: its automated driving software could inaccurately predict the movement of a towed vehicle. The software had been updated on all affected vehicles by January 12, 2024.

Two unoccupied Waymo robotaxis separately collided with the same improperly towed pickup truck in Phoenix, Arizona on December 11, 2023, resulting in minor damage and no injuries, prompting Waymo's first-ever software recall.
A robotic vacuum cleaner's lithium battery caught fire inside a Miami Gardens home, resulting in a 20-year-old man being airlifted to hospital with injuries.

A Daxbot sidewalk robot being directed through a crosswalk by a human operator was struck and damaged by a truck making a right turn at the intersection of West Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard and North Palace Avenue in Tyler, Texas.
A delivery robot rammed into the back of a pedestrian's leg in Lincoln Park, Chicago, prompting a petition calling for a pause on robot deliveries citing collisions with people, pets, and bicyclists.

A Tesla remote operator, while attempting to maneuver an autonomous Model Y out of a dead-end residential road in Houston, drove the vehicle into a hidden tree stump at 2 mph, causing minor property damage.
GM Cruise robotaxi injury lawsuit sent to arbitration due to sign-in wrap agreement
An unoccupied Waymo robotaxi struck a guard gate barrier arm at the entrance of a condo community in Miami-Dade County; no injuries were reported.
Tesla's robotaxi service reported to have long waits and stalled rides during operation

A mass system malfunction caused at least a hundred Baidu Apollo Go robotaxis to stop mid-traffic in Wuhan, with police reporting no injuries and passengers exiting their vehicles safely, though one social media video appeared to show a highway collision.

Tesla unredacted 17 autonomous driving crash reports filed with NHTSA covering incidents from July 2025 through March 2026 in Austin, Texas, revealing that of the crashes involving its Robotaxi fleet, 13 resulted in property damage only, 2 had no injuries, 1 involved a minor injury without hospitalization, and 1 involved a minor injury requiring hospitalization.

Tesla reported an eighth crash involving its Robotaxi fleet in Austin, Texas, occurring in October 2025, with no injuries reported, while the vehicle was proceeding straight and came into contact with an unspecified object or party.
Waymo robotaxis were involved in an accident on their first day of operations in Charlotte.

Tesla reported three accidents involving its Robotaxi service Model Y vehicles in Austin, Texas, in July 2025, including one with a minor injury and two with only property damage, while redacting narrative details from NHTSA filings.
A Waymo robotaxi stalled during a wildfire near I-280 and was moved to safety by the California Highway Patrol.
Waymo robotaxis entered closed highway work zones, prompting a California DMV highway ban and two safety recalls
A Waymo robotaxi stalled on a narrow bridge over the Venice Canals during a holiday boat parade, causing a 45-minute traffic backup of at least a mile.

Waymo resumed its San Francisco robotaxi service on Sunday evening after a temporary suspension caused by widespread blackouts, with a spokesperson stating the company worked with city officials throughout the outage and had proactively initiated the pause.

During a widespread power outage affecting approximately 130,000 PG&E customers in San Francisco, multiple Waymo robotaxis stalled in traffic and clogged roadways, prompting the company to suspend its ride-hailing service until the following day.

A Baidu Apollo RT6 robotaxi operated by Hello collided with two pedestrians on Yanjiang Road in Zhuzhou, China, trapping one person beneath the vehicle; both a man and a woman were transported to the ICU.
A Hellobike robotaxi struck two pedestrians on a street in Zhuzhou, Hunan province, China, prompting local authorities to suspend the company's robotaxi operations in the city.
Three Waymo robotaxis became deadlocked on a San Francisco street after two navigated into a dead end and a third behaved erratically, requiring a human Waymo employee to manually move each vehicle.
A Waymo robotaxi entered a drive-thru the wrong way in Los Angeles, causing concern for a waiting passenger's family before the vehicle stopped and the passenger boarded.
An unoccupied Waymo robotaxi stopped between a railroad crossing arm and the tracks in Texas, remaining stationary as a train passed within inches of the vehicle.
An unoccupied Waymo robotaxi stopped at a traffic light was rear-ended in a multi-vehicle collision at Sixth and Harrison Streets in San Francisco, killing one person and injuring seven others.
A Tesla Robotaxi (Model Y) drove into the side of a parked Toyota Camry in the parking lot of Home Slice Pizza in Austin after completing a drop-off, lightly grazing the Camry's right tire.
A Waymo robotaxi stalled while making a U-turn in front of Vice President Kamala Harris' motorcade in San Francisco, requiring an SFPD officer to manually drive the vehicle out of the way.

A Tesla Robotaxi safety monitor used the In Lane Stop button on the main display to halt the autonomous vehicle and prevent a potential low-speed collision with a reversing UPS truck while the robotaxi was pulling over to a destination in Austin, Texas.
A Tesla Robotaxi in the parking lot of Home Slice Pizza in Austin inexplicably turned into a parked Toyota Camry, lightly grazing its door with the vehicle's tire.

A Tesla Robotaxi crashed into a fixed object in a parking lot in Austin, Texas in September 2025, causing property damage but no injuries, representing the fourth reported crash since the service launched in late June 2025.

A Waymo robotaxi parked in a bike lane on Seventh Street in San Francisco opened its rear passenger door into a cyclist, ejecting her into a second Waymo and causing serious injuries including a brain injury and spine damage.

A Waymo robotaxi made an illegal stop in a bike lane in San Francisco and a disembarking passenger opened the door into a cyclist, throwing her into a second Waymo robotaxi and causing brain, spinal, and soft tissue injuries.

Two Cruise autonomous vehicles stopped in traffic lanes on August 14, 2023 in San Francisco, allegedly delaying an ambulance transporting a pedestrian with life-threatening injuries who later died at the hospital, though Cruise disputes that its vehicles impeded the ambulance.
U.S. government launches safety investigation into Waymo and Zoox self-driving vehicles
Two Zoox autonomous robotaxis made unexpected rapid braking maneuvers that caused rear-end crashes with motorcyclists, who sustained minor injuries, prompting an NHTSA investigation.
A Waymo robotaxi collided with a bicyclist at the intersection of 17th and Mississippi Streets in San Francisco's Potrero Hill neighborhood, leaving the cyclist with minor scratches.
Waymo robotaxi collided with a cyclist at a San Francisco intersection, drawing regulatory review.
A robot vacuum cleaner explosion caused a fire at a home in Brabham, Perth, leaving a man in his 20s with life-threatening burns over approximately 75% of his body and destroying the home.
A robot vacuum cleaner knocked a heat gun onto the floor of a Kailua home, causing it to turn on and start a fire that resulted in approximately $760,000 in damage to the structure and contents.

A proposed class action lawsuit alleges that Ecovacs Deebot robot vacuums contain a defective motor built from substandard materials that causes the devices to fail prematurely and become wholly inoperable.

A robotic vacuum cleaner docked in its charging station caused a fire in a bungalow in Holland-on-Sea, Essex, resulting in two residents being treated for smoke inhalation and the lounge being severely damaged.
iRobot warned owners that certain Roomba i7+ Clean Base docking stations could malfunction and present a hazard if liquids collected by the robot vacuum were deposited into the unit.
A 52-year-old woman in Changwon, South Korea had her hair sucked into a robot vacuum cleaner while she was sleeping on the floor, requiring firefighters to free her.
Hospitals sue surgical robot maker over allegedly restrictive contracts
Class certified for purchasers in antitrust lawsuit against surgical robot manufacturer

Lawsuits allege that microscopic cracks in the insulating covers of the da Vinci Surgical System's Monopolar Curved Scissors allowed electrical current to leak and burn patients during minimally invasive surgeries at hospitals across the United States.

Asensus Surgical issued a customer alert on September 15, 2023, warning that the Senhance surgical robot's laparoscope instrument actuator could rotate continuously after disconnection from its remote control, posing a risk of tissue trauma, though no patient harm occurred, and the FDA classified it as a Class I recall.

A patient alleged that inadequately insulated electrified scissors on the da Vinci robotic surgical system caused internal injuries during a 2009 hysterectomy, resulting in intestinal prolapse and emergency surgery requiring a hip-to-hip incision.
Shareholders filed a derivative lawsuit against Intuitive Surgical alleging the company underreported adverse events and concealed recalls related to its da Vinci surgical robot.

Tesla's Robotaxi fleet in Austin accumulated 14 crashes since June 2025, including one July 2025 incident later upgraded to require hospitalization, with the fleet crashing at approximately four times the rate of human drivers by Tesla's own benchmark.

Tesla's Optimus humanoid robot production is reported to be severely behind schedule due to technical bottlenecks with robot hands, with mostly complete units missing hands piling up at Tesla's facility.

Tesla announced in its Q3 2026 earnings report and call that early Optimus robot production has begun at its Fremont, California facility, though Musk cautioned a full rollout remains roughly a year away.

During the 'Spot's Rampage' interactive art exhibit in a Brooklyn studio, a Boston Dynamics Spot robot equipped with a paintball gun malfunctioned and collapsed on its side approximately one hour after users began remotely controlling it to destroy artwork inside the space.

An FDNY Boston Dynamics Spot robodog fell over onto its side while surveying the rubble of a collapsed parking garage in Manhattan, though it later recovered and helped locate the remains of a worker who died in the collapse.
A Boston Dynamics robot dog fell down a flight of stairs and broke during a demonstration at Jaguar Land Rover's battery testing facility in Coventry.

A video compilation shows multiple delivery robot incidents, including a Coco Robotics bot struck by a train, a Starship Technologies robot disrupting a marching band in Tennessee, a Coco bot dragged by a car in Los Angeles, another Coco bot falling down stairs, and a Serve Robotics bot left with a damaged tire after a collision.

A Starship Technologies food delivery robot waiting in a curb ramp on Forbes Avenue at Pitt's campus blocked the path of a wheelchair-using doctoral student, forcing her to alter her route to reach the sidewalk.
A Starship Technologies delivery robot veered into a canal near New Bradwell in Milton Keynes and had to be retrieved by the company.
Two Starship delivery robots faced a stalemate on a Cambridge street corner, unable to pass each other.
A Pony.ai autonomous vehicle operating in driverless mode struck a center divider and traffic sign on Fremont Blvd in Fremont, California, sustaining moderate damage with no injuries reported.
A Waymo robotaxi collided with a Serve Robotics sidewalk delivery robot at an intersection in West Hollywood, Los Angeles, with neither vehicle sustaining damage.

A Waymo robotaxi slowing to turn into a parking lot on Rural Road near Arizona State University was rear-ended by a motorcyclist, who was then struck by a hit-and-run human driver and later died at the hospital.
The California DMV asked Cruise to halve its active driverless fleet in San Francisco while it investigated recent incidents, including the fire truck crash.

A Cruise self-driving robotaxi was struck by a San Francisco Fire Department truck en route to an emergency at the intersection of Polk and Turk Streets in the Tenderloin district, resulting in one passenger being transported to a hospital with non-severe injuries.
A Cruise robotaxi ran over and pinned a woman who had been struck by a hit-and-run driver into its path at Market and Fifth streets in San Francisco around 9:30 p.m., leaving her seriously injured.
California suspends GM Cruise unit's driverless vehicle permit

According to the Los Angeles Times, California's DMV suspended Cruise's driverless operating permit on Tuesday (Oct. 24, 2023) over safety concerns and alleged misleading statements about the Oct. 2 pedestrian incident, while NHTSA weighed its own action.

According to the Los Angeles Times, California's DMV suspended Cruise's driverless operating permit on Tuesday, alleging the company misled the agency about the robotaxi dragging the pedestrian about 20 feet, while NHTSA was also investigating.

Following an October 2 incident in which a Cruise robotaxi struck and dragged a pedestrian in San Francisco, Cruise halted driverless operations across all its fleets and subsequently recalled 950 driverless vehicles, issuing an over-the-air software update to its automated driving system.

According to The Guardian, Cruise recalled all 950 of its autonomous vehicles to update software following the October 2023 pedestrian-dragging incident and California's revocation of its robotaxi permits.

According to Reuters, Cruise recalled 950 driverless cars after NHTSA published a notice that the collision detection software could respond improperly after a crash, following the October 2023 pedestrian-dragging incident in San Francisco.
GM's Cruise faces fine for alleged cover-up of severity of a San Francisco robotaxi accident.

According to The New York Times, Cruise released a roughly 100-page law firm report finding its executives did not intentionally mislead California regulators about the October 2023 pedestrian-dragging crash but failed to explain key details and took an adversarial approach that led to the fleet grounding, while Cruise said the Justice Department, SEC, state agencies and NHTSA were investigating its handling of the incident.
GM Cruise robotaxi unit faces US government probes after a pedestrian-dragging incident and vows reforms.

According to CBS San Francisco (citing the Quinn Emanuel report), GM's Cruise is facing a U.S. Justice Department investigation and a separate SEC inquiry over the October 2023 pedestrian-dragging collision, with Cruise having offered to pay $75,000 against a possible $1.5 million fine.

According to Die Zeit, Cruise announced it is returning vehicles to public roads approximately six months after the October 2023 pedestrian-dragging incident, beginning with human-driven mapping runs in Phoenix, Arizona, with autonomous test drives involving safety drivers planned as a subsequent step.

A Cruise robotaxi hit a woman crossing the street in San Francisco, dragged her more than 20 feet, and pinned her under the vehicle, resulting in a settlement reported to be between $8 million and $12 million.
Cruise recalled 1,194 self-driving robotaxis to resolve a federal safety probe into unexpected hard-braking events, which NHTSA linked to 10 crashes including four that injured vulnerable road users.
NHTSA said Cruise will pay a $1.5 million penalty in connection with the San Francisco pedestrian crash.
Docket No. 3:24-cr-00572 filed in District Court, N.D. California: criminal case, United States v. Cruise, LLC.
Cruise admitted submitting a false report to federal authorities and agreed to pay a $500,000 fine.
According to AP News, NHTSA closed its preliminary investigation into General Motors' Cruise robotaxis.
Waymo recalls 672 self-driving vehicles following a collision in Arizona
Zoox agrees to software recall after self-driving robotaxi crash in Las Vegas

Zoox issued a voluntary software recall for 258 vehicles equipped with autonomous driving software released before November 5, 2024, following two incidents in which motorcyclists collided with the rear of Zoox-equipped Toyota Highlanders that were operating with their autonomous systems engaged.

A Unitree G1 humanoid robot lost its balance while performing in front of a crowd in China, flailed its limbs during a recovery attempt, and kicked a man (apparently its operator) in the nose, causing bleeding and a possible fracture.
Docket No. 5:25-cv-10094 filed in District Court, N.D. California: civil suit against Figure AI.

A former Figure AI principal robotic safety engineer filed a lawsuit alleging he was fired in September 2025 after warning executives that the company's humanoid robots were powerful enough to fracture a human skull, citing an incident in which a malfunctioning robot narrowly missed an employee and carved a quarter-inch gash into a steel refrigerator door.

Figure AI retired its Figure 02 humanoid robots after an 11-month deployment at BMW Manufacturing's Spartanburg, South Carolina plant, where they loaded sheet-metal parts and contributed to the production of over 30,000 BMW X3 vehicles, accumulating visible wear and tear but no reported injuries.

A software engineer inadvertently discovered a security vulnerability in DJI's backend servers that granted him access to live camera feeds, microphone audio, floor maps, and status data from nearly 7,000 DJI Romo robot vacuums across 24 countries.

NASA's Robonaut 2 humanoid robot, developed with General Motors and installed on the International Space Station, suffered progressive hardware failures beginning in 2015 traced to a missing ground cable and was being returned to Earth for repairs as of February 2018.
A Unitree G1 humanoid robot deviated from its planned martial arts demonstration at a UFC event in Shanghai and moved toward UFC boss Dana White, who dodged away unharmed.

A humanoid robot malfunctioned at a festival in China and moved toward attendees, prompting security guards to intervene; authorities confirmed the malfunction was unexpected and that the robot had passed prior tests.

A Unitree H1 humanoid robot malfunctioned during testing at a Chinese factory, flailing its arms and legs while suspended from a crane, knocking a computer and other items to the floor as a worker attempted to stabilize it.
A humanoid robot kicked a man in the groin area during a sparring session, drawing Elon Musk's reaction.

A robotics company employee in his 40s was crushed to death by a robotic arm at a pepper sorting plant in South Gyeongsang province, South Korea, after the arm confused him for a box of vegetables and pushed him against a conveyor belt.

CBS News, citing Goseong police on Thursday, reports police are investigating whether the pick-and-place robot had technical defects or safety issues, and also examining possible human error since camera footage showed the worker near the robot holding a box.
A 45-year-old worker was crushed and killed by a robotic machine while working his shift at Palermo's Pizza's facility in West Milwaukee, Wisconsin, at approximately 6:30 a.m.
Dunedin robotics company charged following a worker's death involving a robot
Employee is killed when crushed by spot welding robot.
A Tesla engineer at the Austin Gigafactory was clawed and pinned to a wall by a robot arm that had not fully shut down, suffering lacerations to his back and arms before falling into a chute.
YouTuber IShowSpeed was set on fire during a livestream when his robot dog equipped with a flamethrower shot flames at him multiple times, causing him to jump into a pool to escape.

A self-driving Tesla Model S struck and destroyed a Promobot v4 autonomous service robot in a parking lot street at 3000 Paradise Road, Las Vegas, while the robot was being transported to the Consumer Electronics Show venue.

Two construction workers in Washington State were severely injured in separate incidents involving remote-controlled demolition robots: one was pinned against a wall with his chest severely crushed, and another suffered broken bones and nerve damage when a machine came down on his foot.
A Baidu Apollo Go robotaxi carrying a female passenger fell into a deep construction pit in Chongqing, China; the passenger was uninjured and rescued by local residents using a ladder.
A Bear Robotics administrative robot employed by Gumi City Council fell down a flight of stairs between the first and second floors of the council building, destroying itself.

A fire believed to have been sparked by a robot vacuum broke out at a Hanyang Apartments unit in Apgujeong-dong, Gangnam District, Seoul, forcing more than 20 residents to evacuate and requiring 133 firefighting personnel to extinguish; one resident suffered dizziness from smoke inhalation.
Hackers remotely took control of Ecovacs Deebot X2 robot vacuums in multiple US cities, using their speakers to yell racial slurs at owners and their cameras to surveil homes.
A cleaning robot caught fire while charging in Ward 76 of Singapore General Hospital, activating the sprinkler system and prompting evacuation of patients, with no injuries reported.
A Roomba robotic vacuum cleaner ran over dog feces and spread the mess across every surface throughout a home in Little Rock, Arkansas.

A 54-year-old man with a T10 complete spinal cord injury sustained bilateral proximal tibial fractures during a powered robotic exoskeleton physiotherapy session, requiring manipulation under anaesthetic and 12 weeks of non-weight-bearing treatment.

A paralyzed former jockey was left unable to use his Rea person exoskeleton after manufacturer Lifeward refused to service the device due to its age, before eventually agreeing to repair it following a public campaign.
Reporter trapped inside a self-driving robotaxi during an anti-robot protest attack on the vehicle.

A man claiming to be an Amazon warehouse employee posted a viral TikTok video showing himself temporarily trapped in an aisle by automatically moving robotic shelving units, taking approximately 15 minutes to find a way out with no reported injury.
Employee is struck by robot and is pinned and killed.
A 57-year-old maintenance employee was trapped in a robotic machine at the Ventra Ionia Main automotive stamping facility in Ionia, Michigan, and died at the scene.
A technician at Ventra Ionia in Michigan was killed in July 2015 when a robot entered the section she was working in and crushed her head between a hitch assembly it was attempting to place.
A man was crushed to death by the compactor mechanism of an automated dumpster in Alexandroupolis, Greece, after reaching inside the bin.
Dallas PD used a robot to kill a suspect after negotiations failed during a standoff.
Robot glitch at Honda factory caused vehicles to be assembled with loose driver's seats, leading to a recall
A Serve Robotics food delivery robot crashed into and shattered the glass of a CTA bus shelter at Grand and Racine in Chicago's West Town neighborhood, with no injuries reported.
Serve Robotics and Coco Robotics delivery robots crashed into CTA bus shelters in Chicago days apart; one incident was caught on camera.
Two sidewalk delivery robots from Serve Robotics and Coco Robotics crashed into CTA bus shelters in Chicago in the same week, shattering glass.
Delivery robots in Chicago reported colliding with bus shelters and bumping into pedestrians.
A Serve Robotics delivery robot crashed into a CTA bus shelter in West Town, Chicago, shattering its glass.
A robotic vacuum exploded at a family home in Fenton, raising concerns about a broader safety problem
A Deebot Ecovac robotic vacuum is suspected of catching fire in a Fort Thomas, Kentucky home, causing damage to the property while the owner escaped unharmed.

A driverless Cruise autonomous vehicle was struck by a semi-truck performing a left turn from the right lane near Golden Gate Park in San Francisco, sustaining damage to its passenger-side mirror, a camera, and a tire, with no passengers in the vehicle and no injuries reported.
A Zoox robotaxi was involved in a crash in San Francisco prior to a separate Las Vegas crash.

An unoccupied Zoox robotaxi was struck by an electric scooter rider after braking to yield at an intersection in San Francisco, causing the rider to fall and sustain minor injuries before declining medical attention, leading Zoox to issue a voluntary software recall for 270 vehicles.

A robot vacuum cleaner reactivated itself on a kitchen worktop in Austria, pushed a cooking pot aside, landed on a hot stove element, melted and caught fire, causing smoke damage that rendered the home uninhabitable.

An employee of N&C Enterprises Ltd. in Kilmeague was struck and killed by a rotating robotic arm after entering a restricted area through a retrofitted gate that bypassed the plant's safety protections.
A worker was crushed to death under a robotic arm.
A newlywed employee at a Co Armagh firm was killed by a falling robot, resulting in the company being fined £50,000.
An Aiper Seagull Pro ZT6001 robotic pool vacuum cleaner caught fire while charging in Canada, prompting a Health Canada recall of 2,606 units sold between July 2023 and April 2024.
A food delivery robot became caught in the middle of a SWAT situation in Chandler, Arizona.
Qualcomm's new AI robot collapsed and malfunctioned during an on-stage demonstration
AI humanoid robot collapsed during a live demonstration in Taiwan, video went viral.

A humanoid robot performing at a university dance event in Shaanxi province, China, unexpectedly moved toward and hugged a female student, with staff quickly intervening; the student was not injured, and the incident was attributed to signal interference from simultaneously operating drones.
Saudi humanoid robot 'Muhammad' allegedly touched a female reporter inappropriately on her back during its public launch at the DeepFast event in Riyadh.
Boston Dynamics' Atlas humanoid robot performed a backflip during a CES 2026 demonstration in Las Vegas, landing successfully but losing its hand in the process.
An unmanned Cruise autonomous vehicle struck a woman's off-leash Labrador in a crosswalk at Clay and Baker streets in San Francisco; the dog was reported uninjured.
